title: The Distance Laplacian and Distance Signless Laplacian Spectra of $\mathcal{C}$-Graphs
summary: Mandal and Mehatari (\emph{Comp.\ Appl.\ Math.}, 2025) introduced the class $\mathcal{C}$ of cographs generated by a finite creation sequence $(α_1,\dots,α_m)$ of natural numbers, and derived the inertia, an extended eigenvalue-free interval, and the exact characteristic polynomial for the \emph{adjacency} matrix of such graphs. In this note we develop the parallel theory for the \emph{distance Laplacian} matrix $D^L(G)$ and \emph{distance signless Laplacian} matrix $D^Q(G)$.
